description:
Priority: P1 (CI). File: .github/workflows/on-merge.yml. Reference: hare.

Problem: No coverage job; the build job has no shared-key so nothing reuses its warmed cache; Docker/helm/checkout actions are a major version behind.

Change:
  - Add a coverage job running `cargo make coverage-flow` via wack/gh-actions/setup-rust@trunk with shared-key: rust-ci and extra-tools: cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov. Add "coverage" to pr-ready.needs.
  - Give the build job shared-key: rust-ci + extra-tools: cargo-nextest so the two share a cache namespace.
  - Bump pins: actions/checkout@v4->v5, docker/setup-buildx-action@v3->v4, docker/login-action@v3->v4, docker/build-push-action@v6->v7, azure/setup-helm@v4->v5.

Acceptance: merge-queue runs produce coverage; pr-ready depends on it; build and coverage share the rust-ci cache key; all action pins match hare's set.
Depends on: TPL-006 (coverage-flow reachable via cargo-make).
title: [TPL-008] Enhance on-merge.yml (coverage + shared cache + pin bumps)
